posts.author: dylanduke1995
posts.body: Is there any way to adjust the movement in MZ? The default movement feels like the characters are gliding and there’s lag between pressing the move button and the movement finishing. I’m not sure how else to describe it. I want the movement to feel more weighted like Pokémon or Zelda.. if that makes sense

posts.author: Delta_
posts.body:
I think your talking about the way the movement is tile locked, like you cant move a little bit at a time, but forced to move a whole tile. There's a plugin I found on itch.io that fixes this, and changes the movement so its more like Deltarune or Earthbound.
Here's the plugin if you want (Its a little bit silly at times, if its not to your standards I'm sure there's some better ones out there)
https://gsioteam.itch.io/rmmz-movement

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: The RPG Maker movement system is tile based, not pixel based. If you want a movement system like that, Look for a pixel movement plugin.
